expectText: What cost-to-collect ratio improvement do organizations with fully integrated RCM systems typically achieve?

set.text: What is the main risk of a best-of-breed RCM technology strategy?
set.explanation: Best-of-breed picks the leading specialized product for each function, which gains depth (for example in denial analytics) but only works if the systems are connected with robust HL7/FHIR interfaces; poorly integrated tools recreate data silos and manual touchpoints. Integrated single-vendor platforms trade some per-function depth for seamless internal data flow.

options.text: Less functional depth in each area
It cannot submit claims in the 837 format
Data silos and manual re-entry if the systems are poorly integrated
It requires every function to come from one vendor

src: No primary source for "30-40% lower cost-to-collect" with fully integrated systems (search 2026-10-09: only vendor case studies and a Black Book self-reported survey citing 27%; nothing matching 30-40%)
